source.text: Has histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of advanced (stage IIIB not amenable to definitive chemoradiotherapy or stage IIIC) or metastatic (stage IV) NSCLC
Has at least 1 radiographically measurable lesion by Computed Tomography (CT) or Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) per RECIST v1.1 criteria.
Has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1
Has progression of disease fewer than 84 days from starting initial anti-Programmed Cell Death (PD)-(L) 1 therapy
Has untreated or active primary brain tumor, Central Nervous System (CNS) metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or spinal cord compression, as described in the protocol
